label: TP
reason: Both alerts are True Positives. Alert 1 (java/xss): User input from Referer header flows through URL decoding to 'bar' which is passed to response.getWriter().format() - attacker-controlled data reaches HTML sink. Alert 2 (java/tainted-format-string): Same flow - 'bar' containing user input is used as format string argument. The sanitization in doSomething() only replaces the last character with 'Z', leaving attacker-controlled prefix intact. Resolved sink value for both alerts is user-controlled 'bar' string derived from request headers.

evidence.note: User input from Referer header flows through URL decoder to bar variable, which is then used as format string argument in response.getWriter().format(bar, obj) - both XSS and format string vulnerabilities present
Sanitization only replaces last character with Z, leaving attacker-controlled prefix in bar - insufficient to prevent XSS/format string attacks
